The Story

Vintage Politics brings together politics, culture and wine. Each guest joins journalist and wine expert Abbie Bennington to talk about the moments that shaped their life and career, with wines chosen to match those defining years.

Every vintage has a backstory. By selecting specific bottles, we unlock conversations that strip away the standard soundbites.

Abbie Bennington

Creator and host of Vintage Politics, Abbie is a journalist, broadcaster, and leading wine expert. A former BBC News at Ten senior producer, she worked alongside Nick Robinson during his time as BBC Political Editor.

  • WSET Diploma
  • Wine writer, educator, and judge
  • Chair of the Association of Wine Educators
  • President of the London Tasting Awards
  • Bordeaux Wine School accredited tutor
